extracted.intended_audience: research teams and institutional leaders preparing NSF Gen-4 ERC center proposals (PIs, administrators, center directors)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing a full proposal for an NSF Gen-4 Engineering Research Center (multi-institutional, convergent, use‑inspired engineering center) that addresses the solicitation's review criteria across research, workforce, diversity, and innovation ecosystem components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convergent Research Project
rubrics_metrics.description: A research project that is use-inspired, has an engineered system focus, and is convergent (multi-disciplinary integration).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposal must center on use-inspired research directed at an engineered system and demonstrate genuine convergence across disciplines (integration, not just parallel work). Reviewers will assess whether the research thrusts connect to form an engineered-system vision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engineering Workforce Development (EWD)
rubrics_metrics.description: A workforce development program that engages participants at all career stages, including K-12 outreach, undergraduate research, graduate training, postdoctoral development, and industry engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should provide cohesive plans spanning K–12 to postdoctoral stages and explicit mechanisms for industry interaction; reviewers will evaluate scope, continuity, and effectiveness of EWD activities across participant stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity and a Culture of Inclusion (DCI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Plans for diversity at all levels of participation; creating a mutually beneficial, inclusive environment; and recruitment and retention of underrepresented groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must describe strategies to recruit, retain, and benefit underrepresented participants and how inclusion is embedded in ERC culture and operations. Reviewers will weigh evidence of institutional commitment and concrete DCI measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation Ecosystem (IE)
rubrics_metrics.description: An innovation ecosystem that produces value that will outlast the ERC, including industry partnerships, translation pathways, entrepreneurship support, and sustainable post-ERC innovation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should show clear translation pathways, entrepreneurship support mechanisms, and partnerships that provide sustainable value-creation beyond the ERC lifetime; reviewers will assess likelihood of sustained impact and realistic pathways to market/translation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address All Four Foundational Components
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must explicitly address the interacting foundational components (Convergent Research Project, EWD, DCI, IE) and how they integrate beyond a research project alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate how research, workforce development, inclusion, and innovation ecosystem activities interact coherently. Reviewers (from diverse expertise areas) will evaluate the integration and mutual reinforcement across components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Plan: define engineered system and integration
rubrics_metrics.description: The Strategic Plan must define the engineered system and explain how ERC features will be integrated to achieve the vision, with a cohesive plan for involving participants at all levels in the four foundational components and vision/goals for each component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strategic Plan should articulate the engineered system, integration of features, specific goals for each foundational component, and concrete participant involvement pathways. Reviewers expect clarity on how individual elements combine to produce the center-level impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management and Leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: A description of proposed management, functions of key personnel, the role of advisory committees, required Student Leadership Council, and Council of Deans to show institutional commitment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear management structure, roles/responsibilities for key staff, advisory and governance mechanisms, student leadership plans, and dean-level institutional commitments. Reviewers will assess organizational capacity and leadership to execute a large, multi-institutional center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision and Goals (Required Plan Component)
rubrics_metrics.description: A clearly articulated set of vision statements and measurable goals for the ERC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vision and goals should be specific, tied to the engineered system, and linked to outcomes across research, workforce, DCI, and innovation. Reviewers will judge clarity, ambition, and realism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Thrusts (interconnected)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interconnected research thrusts that together advance the engineered-system vision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thrusts must be well-defined, show interconnections, and demonstrate how combined efforts will achieve the center's technical goals. Reviewers will look for coherence, multidisciplinary integration, and feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engineering Workforce Development Plan (Required Plan Component)
rubrics_metrics.description: A comprehensive EWD plan detailing activities across K-12, undergraduate, graduate, postdoctoral, and industry engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include curricula, experiential learning, mentoring, industry internships/partnerships, and metrics for workforce outcomes. Reviewers evaluate scope, continuity, scaling, and evidence-based practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity and Culture of Inclusion Plan (Required Plan Component)
rubrics_metrics.description: A dedicated plan describing how diversity and inclusion will be cultivated and sustained across the ERC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe recruitment/retention strategies, inclusive practices, metrics for DCI progress, and how DCI is integrated into governance and activities. Reviewers expect concrete actions and measures of impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation Ecosystem Plan (Required Plan Component)
rubrics_metrics.description: A plan for industry partnerships, translation pathways, entrepreneurship support, and sustainability of innovation beyond the ERC term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide partnership agreements, pathways for technology translation, startup/entrepreneurship support, and plans for sustaining innovation post-award. Reviewers assess realism of pathways and depth of industry engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Management Plan (Required Plan Component)
rubrics_metrics.description: A plan describing the overall management approaches, decision-making processes, and mechanisms to integrate all ERC components strategically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include timelines, milestones, risk management, integration mechanisms across components, and evaluation processes. Reviewers look for operational clarity and capacity to manage large-scale, multi-institutional activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability Plan (Required Plan Component)
rubrics_metrics.description: A plan describing how the ERC's activities, partnerships, and impacts will be sustained beyond the initial award period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show revenue/partnership models, institutional commitments, and strategies for long-term continuity of innovation and workforce efforts. Reviewers will evaluate plausibility of sustaining value after NSF funding ends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry Partnerships (Required Plan Component)
rubrics_metrics.description: Evidence of strong industry partnerships that contribute to research, workforce development, and innovation pathways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document existing and planned partnerships, roles of industry partners, commitments (financial, in-kind, collaboration), and mechanisms for translation. Reviewers weigh the depth and strategic alignment of industry engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education Partnerships (Required Plan Component)
rubrics_metrics.description: Partnerships with educational institutions and programs to support broad workforce and education goals (K‑12 through higher education).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe partnerships, roles, curricula alignment, outreach strategies, and plans for scaling educational impacts. Reviewers assess reach, equity, and effectiveness of education collaborations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Across Components
rubrics_metrics.description: A budget that allocates resources across all ERC components (research, EWD, DCI, IE, management) consistent with proposed activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budgets should be realistic, justified, and aligned with strategic priorities; include cost-share where required. Reviewers assess whether resources match proposed scope and whether cost-share commitments are credible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to Solicitation-Specific Review Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must explicitly respond to the solicitation-specific review criteria used by trained, multidisciplinary reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because reviewers receive explicit instructions and training, proposals should map sections to the stated review criteria, use clear headings, and provide evidence addressing each criterion. Failure to respond explicitly risks being downgraded by reviewers from non-engineering perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition Stages & Submission Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhere to the staged competition process: Letter of Intent, Pre-proposal (concept), selection for full proposal invitation, then full proposal (and potential site visit).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow each stage's requirements and deadlines. Pre-proposal must align with concept expectations to be invited; full proposal must be comprehensive. Reviewers will only evaluate materials submitted at each appropriate stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full Proposal Completeness
rubrics_metrics.description: The full proposal must be comprehensive across all required components (strategic plan, management plan, EWD, DCI, IE, sustainability, partnerships, budget).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A successful full proposal ties together strategic, management, research, workforce, DCI, and innovation plans with supporting documentation and evidence of capacity. Proposals incomplete across components are at risk during review and site visit assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site Visit Preparedness
rubrics_metrics.description: Be prepared for a multi-day site visit by NSF and an external panel for shortlisted proposals that will conduct in-depth evaluation of plans, capacity, and partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shortlisted centers must be able to demonstrate operational capacity, partnerships, student leadership, management structures, and integration across components in person. Reviewers use the site visit to validate claims and scrutinize implementation readiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Expectations, Duration, and Cost Share
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand award details: typical 5-year initial award (renewable to 10 years), typical total budget ~$25–35M (~$5–7M/year), multi-institutional collaboration, and substantial cost-share expected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should plan budgets and institutional commitments consistent with award scale and required cost-share; demonstrate multi-institutional agreements and capacity to manage large awards. Reviewers will consider financial realism and institutional buy-in.
